slides.title: AI Updates Skills v1.1.1 Interactive discovery, open source
slides.text: AI Updates Skills v1.1.1 Interactive discovery, open source release, and agent support https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills Problem - Agents not invoking (ignoring) skills This happens because most frontier models are not yet fully trained on using skills compared to standard tool usage Surprisingly, adding skills sometimes performed worse than the baseline The most effective alternative is using an "agents.md" or "clode.md" file to house grounding information Instead of relying on autonomous skill invocation, developers should stuff summarized documentation directly into these grounding files By compressing context - for instance, from 40KB to 8KB - developers can mitigate "context rot" while ensuring the agent actually follows the necessary instructions and documentation http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A_1ELXEVp5w

slides.title: Claude Code Updates Key Claude Code Updates and
slides.text: Claude Code Updates Key Claude Code Updates and tweaks by Yaron Been Main update - Native Persistent Memory http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AbGBM-aGDJw Tasks & Dependencies - Claude can now create tasks with dependencies that are stored in metadata and the file system Collaboration - Multiple sessions or sub-agents can collaborate on the same task list, and updates are broadcasted across all active sessions Replacement for "Beads" the native solution replaces the need for third-party repositories like "Beads," which previously handled persistent to-do lists for AI agents New Workflow Enhancements & Skills 1. Test-Driven Development (TDD) in Plan Mode - write tests first in Claude's "plan mode" 2. Use Codex MCP to write the tests and Claude to write the code to pass them, leveraging the different "perspectives" of the two models 3. Use "Reinforce" command that spins up six concurrent agents (three Codex, three Opus 4.5). They analyze code for bugs, security breaches, UX/UI improvements, and performance . 4. CLI status line to show context window usage (e.g., % of 200k tokens) and an error counter tracking number of errors 5. A script to skim local conversation logs to identify recurring errors , helping to spot patterns in where the AI is struggling 6. Docker "YOLO" Mode - for research or tasks that don't require manual approval, run Claude Code in an isolated Docker container  using YOLO mode. This prevents the AI from cluttering local environment while avoiding constant permission prompts 7. "Thinking Critically" Skill - a custom command that forces Claude to challenge the user's assumptions, identify implicit constraints, perform trade-off analysis, and conduct a "failure-first" analysis before writing code Yaron mentions that he is becoming more selective about testing new AI repositories. He believes that if a third-party solution (like "Beads") is truly valuable, it will eventually be natively integrated into major tools like Claude Code or OpenCode, so he prefers to "double down" on what is already working Yaron Been

slides.title: Jensen Huang: "Stop Coding" NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang
slides.text: Jensen Huang: "Stop Coding" NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang stated that he wants his engineers to spend "exactly zero percent" of their time writing code, with AI tools handling the coding tasks instead Huang articulated this vision during an appearance on the No Priors AI podcast in January 2026, where he revealed that every engineer at NVIDIA now uses Cursor, an AI coding assistant, throughout their workday According to Huang, coding is merely a task—the mechanical implementation—while the true purpose of engineering is discovering and solving problems that haven't yet been identified He stated, "Nothing would give me more joy than if none of our engineers were coding at all, and they were just purely solving undiscovered problems" https://www.linkedin.com/posts/linasbeliunas_jensen-huang-just-said-the-quiet-part-out-activity-7418389362226233344-WqLu At a recent NVIDIA all-hands meeting, Huang reportedly challenged managers who were asking teams to limit AI tool usage, saying "Are you insane?" His goal is to free engineers entirely from what he calls "syntax" so they can focus on higher-level system architecture, algorithmic development, and tackling complex, unresolved challenges Huang has been advocating this "Purpose vs Task" idea across multiple public conversations Huang's vision aligns with broader industry trends and statements from Google CEO Sundar Pichai and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei However even Andrej Karpathy, former Tesla AI director who coined the term "vibe coding," admitted his recent project was "basically entirely hand-written" because AI agents "just didn't work well enough".

slides.title: Claude-Flow Claude-Flow v3: Enterprise AI Orchestration Platform AI
slides.text: Claude-Flow Claude-Flow v3: Enterprise AI Orchestration Platform AI multi-agent orchestration dev. framework, open-source By Reuven Cohen (GitHub: ruvnet), Toronto Area, Canada Teams can deploy, coordinate, and optimize specialized AI agents working together on complex software engineering tasks 13.2K stars on Github CLI and MCP server for command and control Uses Q-Learning and MoE with 8 experts, 42+ skills, and 17 hooks to intelligently direct tasks Swarm Coordination - manages agents using various topologies (mesh, hierarchical, ring, star) and consensus mechanisms (Raft, BFT, Gossip, CRDT) Includes 54+ specialized agents (coder, tester, reviewer, architect, security, etc.) Memory system (AgentDB) , multiple LLM providers (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Ollama), and 12 workers for tasks like ultralearn, audit, and optimize Hive-Mind Architecture - a "Queen" agent acts as the master orchestrator The Queen doesn't write code directly but analyzes tasks, breaks them into logical subtasks, delegates to appropriate worker agents, monitors progress, and manages communication This allows multiple specialized agents to work simultaneously on different parts of a project while sharing knowledge through an intelligent memory bank. Advanced Intelligence (RuVector) Version 3 introduces self-learning neural capabilities through RuVector components: SONA = Self-Optimizing Neural Architecture - learns optimal routing in <0.05ms EWC++ = Elastic Weight Consolidation - preventing catastrophic forgetting (preserves 95%+ knowledge) Flash Attention - Optimized computation with 2.49x-7.47x speedup HNSW - Vector search 150x-12,500x faster than traditional methods LoRA/MicroLoRA - Efficient fine-tuning with 128x compression Get started: npx claude-flow@v3alpha init The framework supports recursive development - it can build and improve itself using the same agents it orchestrates https://github.com/ruvnet/claude-flow https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1l87dj7/claudeflow_multiagent_orchestration_platform_for/

slides.title: Moltbot (originally Clawdbot) Moltbot - open source, local
slides.text: Moltbot (originally Clawdbot) Moltbot - open source, local personal AI Assistant Written in TypeScript, combines "Claude Code" with persistent memory and extensive computer access. Connects WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Signal, iMessage , emails, calendars, cameras, smart-home devices, ... to models such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, xAI Grok, Mistral and local backends Uses tools via standard SKILL.md format Its workflow runtime " Lobster " executes multi-step, typed pipelines with explicit approvals and resumable state Clawdbot runs on your own hardware or a small VPS It uses cron-like scheduling, integrates with notes, tasks, repos and smart home systems Created by Peter Steinberger - an Austrian software engineer and serial entrepreneur originally from Vienna, Austria, who now splits his time between Vienna and London Peter Steinberger changed the name from ClawdBot to Moltbot on January 27, 2026. Original name was based on "Clawd," the Claude Code mascot, and Anthropic owned the trademark AI agent needed to "molt" (shed its shell) to adopt a new identity. So it was called "Moltbot" as a fitting reference to the lobster theme https://Molt.bot https://github.com/moltbot/moltbot http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MUDvwqJWWIw Clawdbot - can write and execute code, manage files (localy and on Google Drive), check emails, and browse the web via a Chrome extension; Can place phone calls It learns your preferences over time and has a customizable "soul.md" file that dictates its personality and behavior Social Media Management - drafting and sending replies to comments on X posts Highly customizable, open-source, runs 24/7, and allows for complex "daisy-chaining" of different AI models The project is only 2 months old, can occasionally crash or get stuck in tool-call loops; security risks if improperly configured Can be installed on Mac, Windows, and Linux npm install -g moltbot@latest moltbot onboard --install-daemon moltbot gateway --port 18789 --verbose moltbot message send --to +1234567890 --message "Hello" moltbot agent --message "Ship checklist" --thinking high 🦞

slides.title: Moltbot Security Disaster In just 72 hours, the
slides.text: Moltbot Security Disaster In just 72 hours, the Moltbot collapsed into a $16 Mln crypto scam and security disaster http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mPWY7qiISoA . During the Clawdbot → Moltbot rebrand, the previous GitHub adn social identities of the project were briefly released - and then grabbed by others within seconds! Automated “handle snipers” and squatters took over the old Clawdbot handle on X and the old GitHub org, then used those to post crypto wallet addresses and imply an “official” token. The token was never official: the project’s creator repeatedly stated he had not launched, endorsed, or planned any token at all. Traders piled in on the assumption this was an early, sanctioned AI-related coin; when the denial hit and liquidity was pulled, late entrants were effectively rugged while the anonymous token creators walked away with large profits. The whole ~ 3-day episode exposed serious security issues in how many people deployed the bot This incident serves as a blueprint for future AI-related scams. Users should remain skeptical of "too good to be true" tools and avoid granting full system access to unverified software in the current "wild west" of AI Independently of the token drama, security researchers scanned the internet and found hundreds of Moltbot/Clawdbot control panels exposed publicly, often with no authentication at all https://www.bitdefender.com/en-us/blog/hotforsecurity/moltbot-security-alert-exposed-clawdbot-control-panels-risk-credential-leaks-and-account-takeovers These exposed instances leaked API keys, OAuth tokens, and conversation histories and, in some cases, allowed unauthenticated command execution on the host system https://vibeaudits.com/blog/64000-github-stars-16m-scam-moltbot-clawdbot-security-nightmare The root cause was not a zero‑day in the code but widespread bad deployments (trusting localhost, misconfigured reverse proxies); given Moltbot’s broad system access, this turned into a high‑impact security incident Several post‑mortems and timelines describe a roughly three‑day window from explosive GitHub popularity, to trademark C&D and rebrand, to handle sniping, token launches, and then mass security scanning and disclosures

slides.title: Eigent - Desktop Personal AI Workforce Eigent is
slides.text: Eigent - Desktop Personal AI Workforce Eigent is an open-source desktop application (Apache 2.0) https://github.com/eigent-ai/eigent - 11.7K stars https://www.camel-ai.org - CAMEL-AI multi-agent framework . Includes Developer agents, Browser agents, Document agents, Multi-Modal agents A startup in UK that went open-source (after release of Claude Co-Work) Deploys a "personal AI workforce" on your local machine, orchestrating multiple specialized AI agents (complex, multi-step tasks, locally) https://www.camel-ai.org/blogs/a-guide-to-building-a-fully-local-ai-workforce-with-eigent Privacy-First Design - everything runs locally on your computer Flexible Deployment - Supports both local-only operation (zero cloud dependency) and cloud-connected (API keys) Extensive Tool Integration - over 200 MCP compatible tools for browser automation, code execution, document processing, terminal access, etc. - and you can also add custom tools Enterprise Features - SSO, access control, human-in-the-loop controls for oversight, and commercial licensing options Eigent fits scenarios requiring automation of multi-step workflows such as research assistance, product research, automated report generation, data cleaning, and office automation. The platform is particularly valuable for developers and teams needing complete control over their AI processes without sending data to external servers. [jimmysong](https://jimmysong.io/ai/eigent/) https://github.com/eigent-ai Claude Co-work Use Cases Desktop File Organization - sorting files into folders/subfolders Browser Control - navigate, do actions, downloads Multitask Parallel Processing - organizing files, creating presentations, managing spreadsheets at once Create Branded Presentation (provide logos, colors) Data Collection (Shopify, CRMs) data Analysis, create visual dashboards Automated Video Editing - find engaging moments, cut into vertical clips optimized for Tik Tok or Instagram Google Workspace - check Google Calendar, schedule  meetings, summarize important emails MCP Server Connections (work with Asana, etc.) Schedule workflows such as generating and posting LinkedIn content at a specific time every day https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eq05p90xyJw

slides.text: OpenAI Reached "High" Level of Cybersecurity "We are going to reach the Cybersecurity High level" - Sam Altman Shifting focus toward "defensive acceleration" to help people patch bugs faster than they can be exploited OpenAI announced that its upcoming Codex coding model updates will reach the "High" cybersecurity level for the first time. https://the-decoder.com/openais-upcoming-codex-update-will-hit-the-companys-high-cybersecurity-risk-level-for-the-first-time/ In response, OpenAI is shifting toward "defensive acceleration," prioritizing AI tools that help people patch vulnerabilities faster than they can be exploited CEO Sam Altman emphasized the importance of rapid adoption of these defensive tools , noting that "there will be many very capable models in the world soon" Initially, OpenAI will implement product restrictions to block misuse, while transitioning toward the defensive acceleration approach as supporting evidence emerges https://x.com/sama/status/2014733975755817267

slides.title: Google & Sakana AI Partnership Google & Sakana
slides.text: Google & Sakana AI Partnership Google & Sakana AI Partnership Google is making a financial investment and forming a strategic partnership with Japan-based Sakana AI. They aim to leverage models like Gemini and Gemma to accelerate breakthroughs in automated scientific discovery Sakana AI is a Tokyo-based AI startup founded in 2023 by David Ha, Llion Jones (co-author of the "Attention Is All You Need" paper), and Ren Ito. The company is famous for its nature-inspired approach to AI development, particularly its Evolutionary Model Merge technique that "breeds" new AI models by combining existing ones rather than training from scratch This method uses evolutionary algorithms to automatically merge open-source models , creating powerful new systems without expensive retraining Other notable innovations include The AI Scientist , which automates scientific research, and the Continuous Thought Machine for brain-like reasoning. The company raised approximately $200 Mln in Series A in 2024.

slides.title: RAG Reasoning Collapse "RAG Reasoning Collapse" - occurs
slides.text: RAG Reasoning Collapse "RAG Reasoning Collapse" - occurs when RAG systems provide information that conflicts with an LLM's pre-trained internal memory Models frequently fail to propagate that new information through complex reasoning chains 2026 study from EPFL and Stony Brook -  internal parametric knowledge often overrides external context, causing the model to hallucinate or revert to outdated facts during multi-step tasks This is particularly problematic in coding or technical fields where logic is intertwined with specific data. Current RAG techniques are fragile for mission-critical applications To truly fix this, the industry may need to move beyond simple retrieval toward more advanced fine-tuning and post-training methods that can effectively "overwrite" an LLM’s fundamental beliefs https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BmzdS-a-G8g

slides.title: Zenflow - Autonomous AI Software Engineer Zenflow is
slides.text: Zenflow - Autonomous AI Software Engineer Zenflow is an autonomous AI software engineering system designed for production-ready, end-to-end development Unlike standard AI tools that rely on simple prompting, Zenflow uses "spec-driven orchestration" to manage multiple AI agents . This ensures code stays aligned with technical requirements and prevents "prompt drift." Key features include parallel execution , where multiple agents work on different modules simultaneously, and autonomous verification agents that test and review code before shipping The platform offers four modes: Quick Changes, Fix Bugs, Spec and Build, and a full Spec-Driven Development (SDD) workflow. Zenflow integrates with GitHub and supports MCP servers for documentation and automation During a demonstration, the system successfully built a complex Habit Tracker app with backend logic and analytics By automating the technical specification and execution phases, Zenflow allows developers to build functional, polished applications at scale with minimal oversight. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xxppO2ws-J8 https://zencoder.ai/zenflow Zencoder is an AI startup founded in 2023 by Andrew Filev It offers an orchestration platform for AI-powered software development with spec-driven workflows and AI coding agents https://www.linkedin.com/in/filev Offers  Zenflow and Zencoder agents Zenflow is the workflow engine that coordinates multi-agent execution and enforces development specifications Zencoder agents handle the actual implementation tasks including code generation, code repair, test generation, and real-time optimization The company's headquarters is located at 500 W Hamilton Avenue in Campbell, California (San Jose area) Zencoder size ~70 people - AI experts, engineers, and data scientists distributed across the globe Spec → Plan → Implement → Test → Verify → Merge Andrew Filev

slides.title: Automated Quality Assurance (QA) The challenge has shifted
slides.text: Automated Quality Assurance (QA) The challenge has shifted from writing code to trusting the code. The Trust Gap - development velocity has exploded, but validation processes are still stuck in slow, manual cycles Competitive advantage shifts to reliability. How to ship software instantly while maintaining total trust in the product's stability - http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MEtDwwi7bEU Abacus AI’s "Deep Agent" - a "mindset-driven" automated QA designed to "think" like a QA engineer, proactively pressure-testing products to find breakpoints Autonomous Workflow - building apps, debugging, monitoring, and scaling Safety Nets - weekly automated testing for "vibe-coded" apps; automatic infrastructure scaling - based on real-time traffic Effective QA requires switching between different user personas. Deep Agent can simulate various perspectives - such as confused users, or those in different global regions Deep Agent checks also for "simple" errors like broken links and UI glitches that cause "quiet" revenue loss (landing pages, order forms) It catches regional UI issues and language variations that might be invisible to the local development team but disruptive 2026 - year of hybrid teams. AI agents handle execution and humans focus on strategy and judgment

slides.text: How to Advertise with AI In this video, PJ Ace, a pioneer in AI-driven advertising , joins the *Marketing Against the Grain* podcast to break down his workflow for creating high-end viral videos , including the David Beckham IM8 ad which garnered 233 million views in just three days https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yUdE9oj3sWk . The best results come from mirroring traditional filmmaking roles. His team utilizes a five-person structure: Writer & Director - script concept, creative vision Cinematographer - Using Ideogram and Google’s Nano Banana Pro to generate visual references and mood boards Animator & Editor -  Taking static images into tools like Kling or V3 to bring scenes to life Storyboarding in Figma - PJ lays out his entire sequence in Figma, placing the voiceover lines next to the corresponding AI-generated shots to ensure visual flow The 2x2 Grid Method - generates four related shots in a single 2x2 grid. This ensures that lighting, character likeness, and location remain consistent across different camera angles Motion Control with Kling - a "driving performance" from a real actor can be used to animate an AI character's face, preserving micro-expressions and nuance Hyper-Niche Content - PJ predicts that AI will lower the cost of storytelling so significantly that we will see a surge in "niche" high-quality series (e.g., specific Star Wars or Warhammer stories) made by small teams for millions rather than 100s  of millions of $ Hybrid Filmmaking - real actors performing on LED backgrounds (like The Mandalorian), while wide shots and complex battle sequences are handled by AI to save costs Cost Efficiency - PJ ballparks that a commercial that used to cost $3 Mln can now be produced for roughly $300,000 (10x cheaper) using these modern AI workflows For "challenger brands," AI offers a way to surprise audiences and compete with major incumbents. However, he warns that major brands (like Coca-Cola) must be more careful, as they face higher scrutiny and "uncanny valley" risks with their established brand equity

slides.text: Git & GitHub Linus Torvalds has created Git in April 2005 in only 5-10 days The motivation was a licensing dispute with BitKeeper GitHub was founded in 2007, launched in April 2008 Microsoft acquired GitHub on October 26, 2018 , for $7.5 Billion In 2024 GitHub's ARR reached 2 Bln GitHub could be valued at approximately $16-18 Bln or more The platform has grown from 28 Mln developers at acquisition to over 150 Mln developers as of 2025, with more than 1 Bln repositories. GitHub Copilot accounts for over 40% of GitHub revenue growth GitHub Copilot had become a larger business on its own than all of GitHub was at the time of acquisition
